## Forecasting Team governance

This document records the Forecasting Team's adoption of the NFWS governance
framework. The team covers three Local Forecasting Teams, one Coastal Modelling
Team, two Fluvial Modelling Teams, and a Senior Technical Advisor.

Core standards are defined in `governance-core` v3.0 and are not repeated here.
